digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 chunk and agent pool execution
propositions: Pass-1 submits all chunks and agent futures concurrently to a 6-wide pool, causing redundant cache writes of the byte-identical plan-bearing system prefix when the cache is cold, resulting in ~3.7x token overhead versus the ideal.

When estimated shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and there are >= 2 Pass-1 calls, the first chunk should run serially to completion (warming the cache) before the remainder fan out to the pool.
Non-systemic warm-call failures must degrade gracefully to direct fan-out of the remainder without aborting the entire review.
Systemic LLMUnavailableError during warm-up should abort the entire review.
Small plans or single-call reviews must bypass the warm-up gate and proceed with the original direct fan-out behavior.
